test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and fourth term is related to the third term.

Rahul : 12 : : Zenus : 17 : : Vinas : ?
solution:
The positional values of English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**LOGIC : Sum of positional values of the word ÷ Number of alphabets in the word**

1) Rahul : 12

Accordingly, RAHUL = 18 + 1 + 8 + 21 + 12 = 60

Number of alphabets in RAHUL = 5

so, 60 ÷ 5 = 12

2) Zenus : 17

Accordingly, ZENUS = 26 + 5 + 14 + 21 + 19 = 85

Number of alphabets in ZENUS = 5

so, 85 ÷ 5 = 17

Similarly, VINAS will be coded as:

VINAS = 22 + 9 + 14 + 1 + 19 = 65

Number of alphabets in VINAS = 5

so, 65 ÷ 5 =** 13**

Hence, **13 **is the **correct answer.**
